fair_value.method: Blend (60/40) of forward P/E and FCF yield on FY2028 numbers, which the market will price in Sep 2027. FY26 EPS ~$8.86 (9M $6.88 + ~$1.98 FQ4, incl. ~$0.11 one-off tariff refund) -> FY27 ~$9.58 (+8%) -> FY28 ~$10.35 (+8%); 30.5x (down from 31x because the 10-yr is ~5.2% and the Fed is hiking) = ~$316 + ~$1.10 dividends = ~$317. FCF cross-check: FY28 FCF/sh ~$10.4 at a 3.2% yield = ~$325. Blend ~$320.

methods.name: Forward P/E on FY2028 EPS
methods.detail: FY28 EPS $10.35 (FY26 $8.86 base, ~8%/yr growth: ~6% revenue, flat-to-slightly-lower product GM as memory at ~$2.00/Gb is offset by price increases, ~2% annual share count reduction) x 30.5x forward (5-yr avg ~27x, today ~35.6x FY27; premium for services mix and AI-Siri/Duo cycle, trimmed for 5%+ 10-yr yields) = $316, plus ~$1.10 dividends.

methods.name: FCF yield on FY2028 FCF per share
methods.detail: TTM FCF ~$137B; FY28 FCF ~$147B on ~14.1B shares = ~$10.4/sh; 3.2% FCF yield (up from 3.0% in round 1 given a 5.17% 10-yr and hiking Fed) = ~$325.

methods.name: Analyst consensus target (cross-check only, not in blend)
methods.detail: Consensus mean target ~$328 (range ~$245-400; BofA $370, Morgan Stanley $360) per 24/7 Wall St. 2026-09-25; consistent with a fair value slightly below spot.

bear.story: Rates keep rising (Fed hikes again, 10-yr well above 5%) and memory at ~$2.00/Gb (+30-40%) with a widening 2027 supply gap (-13.6%) pushes product GM below ~36% while price hikes dent iPhone 18/Duo units; FY27 EPS slips toward ~$9.0 and FY28 to ~$9.4, and the multiple de-rates to ~26x = ~$245. A punitive China chip-tariff rate on 2027-06-23 or an adverse D.C. Circuit ruling on Google payments deepens it.

base.story: iPhone 18 Pro/Duo cycle (Duo production-constrained, not demand-constrained) and Gemini-based Siri keep revenue growing ~6-8%; memory costs are absorbed through pricing, so GM settles ~46-47%; services grow ~10-12% reported with FX drag fading; EPS ~$9.6 FY27 and ~$10.35 FY28. Multiple compresses from ~35.6x FY27 to ~32x FY28 under higher rates, leaving the stock roughly flat plus ~0.3% dividend.

bull.story: Duo supply ramps and the upgrade cycle broadens across the ~1.5B+ iPhone base; price increases more than offset memory (no cost relief needed), GM holds ~47-48%; AI services monetization emerges; FY28 EPS ~$11.2 and, if rate fears ease, the market keeps ~37-38x.

thesis_break_reason: ~27% below $341 and ~26x FY27 EPS of $9.58, just above the 52-week low ($243). With a 5%+ 10-year and a hiking Fed, de-rating to ~28-30x on unchanged estimates could take the stock to the $270s-$290s without anything broken, so I lowered the break from $255. A close under ~$250 would most likely mean estimates are being cut: GM guided well below 46% as $2/Gb memory outruns price increases, iPhone 18/Duo unit declines after price hikes, loss of the Google default-search payment, or a punitive June-2027 China chip-tariff rate.

reasoning: Round 2 revision. The supervisor's fact-checks, which I verified, moved me lower. (1) My FY26 base was wrong: 9M FY26 diluted EPS is $6.88, so FY26 is ~$8.86, not $8.51. FY27 consensus of ~$9.58 is therefore only ~8% growth, and FY26 includes a ~$0.11 one-off tariff refund. I cut FY28 EPS from $10.55 to $10.35. (2) Rates: the Fed hiked 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on 9/16, 16 of 18 participants see another hike, and the 10-yr hit 5.18% (cycle high) on 9/24 and closed near 5.17% on 9/25 (the supervisor dated the 5.18% to 9/25; minor). An earnings yield of ~2.8% against a ~5.2% risk-free rate justifies a lower target multiple (30.5x vs 31x) and a higher FCF yield (3.2% vs 3.0%). (3) Memory: 2027 DRAM near $2.00/Gb with the supply gap widening to -13.6% removes the 'memory peaks by mid-2027' leg of my bull case, so the bull price and probability fall. (4) Services slowdown is mostly FX; I trim my services assumption to ~10-12% reported, a small negative. (5) Google: the remedies currently allow non-exclusive payments, so this is a tail risk, not the base case. My round-1 catalyst wording ('DOJ seeks ban') overstated the near-term risk. Fair value $320 (from $330), ~6% below spot. I do not go further, because Duo demand looks supply-limited (Evercore, BofA $370), the stock is at record highs with momentum, ~2% buyback carry, and the rate shock is already in the $341 close. Distribution: median ~$335, log-vol ~27% with a fatter left tail (rate-driven de-rating). Scenarios bear $245 (27%) / base $340 (50%) / bull $425 (23%), mean ~$334. P(>=341) = 0.48 (from 0.53), P(>=409) 0.23, P(<239) ~11.5%.
